# IAM List Resource for Topic

For how list resources work in this provider, file layout, Terraform version requirements, and 
shared `list` block arguments, refer to the guide 
[Use list resources with terraform query (Google Cloud provider)](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/guides/using_list_resources_with_terraform_query).

## google_pubsub_topic_iam_member (list)

Lists IAM **member bindings** for a Google Cloud Topic for use with 
[`terraform query`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/query) and **`.tfquery.hcl`** files.

Results correspond to existing
[`google_pubsub_topic_iam_member`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/resources/pubsub_topic_iam)
managed resources.

### Example

```hcl
list "google_pubsub_topic_iam_member" "all" {
  provider = google

  config {
    topic = "my-topic"
  }
}
```

Run `terraform query` from the directory that contains the `.tfquery.hcl` file.

### Configuration (`config` block)

* topic - The parent Topic identifier used to scope IAM member bindings.
* role - Optional IAM role filter
* member - Optional IAM member filter


### Results

By default each result includes **resource identity** for [`google_pubsub_topic_iam_member`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/resources/pubsub_topic_iam) (see [Resource identity](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import#resources-identity)).

With `include_resource = true` on the `list` block, results also include the full resource-style attributes documented for the managed [`google_pubsub_topic_iam_member` resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/resources/pubsub_topic_iam#attributes-reference).
